name: JustiSolve
description: JustiSolve mobile client for private legal workspaces, role profiles, case records and configured AI tools. Uses your existing account and the live JustiSolve platform.
features: Public demo accounts and user sandbox
Home, Demo, Install, Reload and Browser controls
limitations: Development preview, internet required. Downloads, camera/video and unsupported flows may require Browser sign-in. No native background calls, push notifications or offline case work. No Google Play or Apple App Store publication. Version 0.2.0 uses a new preview certificate: uninstall version 0.1.0 first; server account data is retained.
